request: Verify real DebugAI PR112 production Gate-mode startup, HTTP health and unchanged exact app/sidecar mount identities after guarded Compose reflection.

bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/.worktrees/pr112-gates-20261016; test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD)" = "bb08aef1d92271d1fb4ab9f37309535811d48180" || exit 23; c=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai); s=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=sandbox-runner); test "$(printf '%s\n' "$c" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 31; test "$(printf '%s\n' "$s" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 32; docker inspect -f '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' "$c" | grep -qx 'DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_DISPATCH_MODE=model_gates' || exit 33; docker inspect -f '{{json .Mounts}}' "$c" | jq -S 'map({Type,Source,Destination,Name,RW})|sort_by(.Destination)' | cmp - /tmp/debugai-pr112-app-mounts-before.json || exit 34; docker inspect -f '{{json .Mounts}}' "$s" | jq -S 'map({Type,Source,Destination,Name,RW})|sort_by(.Destination)' | cmp - /tmp/debugai-pr112-sidecar-mounts-before.json || exit 35; pass=0; for i in $(seq 1 20); do if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8787/health | grep -q '"service":"debug-ai"'; then pass=1; break; fi; sleep 2; done; test "$pass" -eq 1 || exit 36
